resolution.plan: The FinanceBench 'Baseline' replicates the FinanceBench paper's LLM prompt under oracle context (A.9.3), but neither the prompt nor the correct/incorrect/unable adjudication is printed; Sec. 9 says the full source code including prompt files is released at bit.ly/prism-ailens. Take the baseline prompt and grader from that code, run the 150 FinanceBench open-set questions with their oracle evidence on gpt-5-2025-08-07, and compare with 141/150 (Tables 4/12).
resolution.approximation: If grading was manual, use a fixed LLM/rule grader and flag.
